name: ANSI/IEEE relay reset coil symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for relay reset coil, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The reset-coil form is a separately drawn operating element of the associated latch relay. Its tag ties it to the retained mechanism rather than to a new unrelated relay, even if the reset appears on another rung.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Follow the reset command to the matching latch-device reference.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A separately drawn reset coil is not an extra set of power contacts.
